data.name: Lokman
data.gender_notes: Lokman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lokman is derived from the Arabic word 'lakama' which means 'to speak' or 'to convey'. This name is attributed to the character Lokman Hafiz Ibn Zaid, who was a wise and intelligent speaker in Islamic history. The name is therefore symbolic of one who is eloquent and knowledgeable. The name Lokman carries the meaning “Intelligent speaker, scholar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lokman usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent speaker, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and understanding. A name for someone who is highly intelligent, thoughtful, and insightful.
data.etymology: Lokman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent speaker, scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lokman total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
